    No, the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is
    closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026. It is a long-standing market holiday, and there will be no trading on that day. The markets will reopen for regular trading hours at 9:30 a.m. ET on Monday, April 6, 2026. 
    Key Details for Good Friday 2026: 
    • NYSE & Nasdaq: Closed on Friday, April 3, 2026.
    • Bond Market: The U.S. bond market will close early at 12 p.m. ET on Friday, April 3.
    • International Markets: Many foreign exchanges, including the London Stock Exchange and Euronext Paris, are closed.
    • Easter Monday:
      Markets are open for normal trading hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
